mapper.select: SELECT ifnull(ifnull(r2.par_category,r1.par_category),i.category) category1, case when r2.par_category is null then i.category else r1.category end category2, case when r2.par_category is null or r1.category is null then null else i.category end category3, i.stock_code,i.stock_name,remarks FROM subject_info i left join subject_rel r1 on i.category_code=r1.category_code left join subject_rel r2 on r1.par_category_code=r2.category_code WHERE i.category_code = #{categoryCode}

SELECT r1.category category1, r2.category category2, r3.category category3, i.stock_code, i.stock_name, i.remarks, k.pre_close, k.high, k.open, k.low, k.close, round(k.vol/10000,1) vol, k.amount, k.pct_chg, k.vr, k.turnover_rate FROM subject_rel r1 LEFT JOIN subject_rel r2 ON r2.par_category_code = r1.category_code LEFT JOIN subject_rel r3 ON r3.par_category_code = r2.category_code LEFT JOIN subject_info i ON IFNULL(IFNULL(r3.category_code, r2.category_code), r1.category_code) = i.category_code LEFT JOIN stock_rt_k_ms k ON k.stock_code = i.stock_code WHERE r1.category_code = #{categoryCode} AND i.stock_code IS NOT NULL

SELECT category_code, category,max(child_category) child_category, ROUND(AVG(pct_chg), 2) pct_chg, CONCAT( SUM(CASE WHEN pct_chg > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '/', SUM(CASE WHEN pct_chg = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '/', SUM(CASE WHEN pct_chg < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) pctdis, ROUND(SUM(vol) / 10000, 1) vol, ROUND(SUM(amount), 1) amount FROM ( SELECT r1.category_code, r1.category, count(distinct r2.category_code) child_category, i.stock_code, k.pct_chg, k.vol, k.amount FROM subject_rel r1 LEFT JOIN subject_rel r2 ON r2.par_category_code = r1.category_code LEFT JOIN subject_rel r3 ON r3.par_category_code = r2.category_code LEFT JOIN subject_info i ON IFNULL(IFNULL(r3.category_code, r2.category_code), r1.category_code) = i.category_code LEFT JOIN stock_rt_k_ms k ON k.stock_code = i.stock_code WHERE
r1.par_category_code = #{categoryCode}
r1.par_category_code IS NULL AND r1.category_type IS NULL
group by r1.category_code, r1.category, i.stock_code,pct_chg,vol,amount ) t GROUP BY category_code, category ORDER BY pct_chg DESC
